newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil suicide bomb hits Sri Lanka police car - army.
newsitem.headline: Tamil suicide bomb hits Sri Lanka police car - army.

text.p: A Tamil Tiger suicide bomber died on Monday in an attack on a police vehicle which critically wounded a police driver, the Ministry of Defence said.

The explosion in Trincomalee in eastern Sri Lanka was the first suicide bomb attack reported since Sri Lankan police went on high alert last week for Heroes' Week, when the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Ealam (LTTE) commemorate those who have died in their 13-year war for an independent Tamil state.
Heroes' Week ends on Wednesday with Heroes Day, which the LTTE has said it will mark with prayers and speeches in areas of northern and eastern Sri Lanka under its control.

An army statement said the attacker "blew himself up in front of the vehicle", which belonged to a senior police official. An army spokeswoman refused to elaborate other than to say no second vehicle was involved in the attack.
The alert has led to a high-profile police presence and stepped up searches of vehicles in the capital Colombo, thought by police to be a target of suicide bomb attacks.
The apparent target of Monday's attack, the Trincomalee senior superintendent of police was not in the vehicle at the time of the explosion, the ministry said.
The Sri Lankan government has blamed the LTTE for major suicide bomb attacks this year on the Central Bank and on a crowded Colombo commuter train, which together killed about 150 people.
